Entities / Items / Whip Shark Eggs

Whip Shark Eggs (×3, fertilized)

Three fertilized eggs recovered by Jean-Claude Tabarnack from the whip shark’s body. Directed to Studio Orsini by a Casa Lupo shopkeeper.

Jean-Claude told Marta Orsini he fertilized the egg himself and that “the infant will have multiple extra muscles.”

Value — Sale to Marta Orsini

75 gp each (225 gp for all three).

Marta pays for alchemical utility, not rarity. Fertilized whip shark eggs are worth substantially more than unfertilized because the developing embryo concentrates venom precursors in the yolk sac — the same compounds Catarina DaVirelli extracts from the barb grinding. The amniotic fluid is a reagent for water-breathing compounds. The shell cartilage has applications in siege-hardening enchantments.

DM Note

Marta examines the eggs in silence for two minutes. She will dismiss JC’s claim about fertilizing them himself and the “multiple extra muscles” with a single flat look. She knows what fertilized whip shark eggs are — she has seen two in her career, both unfertilized, both from Drowned Maw expeditions. Three fertilized eggs from a specimen this far west is genuinely unusual. She will not say that. She will name a price.

Mechanic

Base offer: 75 gp per egg (225 gp total). DC 14 Persuasion (JC has disadvantage — Mortis): 85 gp each (255 gp). DC 18 Persuasion or offering her first pick of the three: 90 gp each (270 gp), plus she owes JC one compound at cost — a future favour worth 30-50 gp in alchemical product. If JC mentions the specimen’s size (60+ feet) or its anomalous range: Marta’s interest sharpens. She adds 10 gp per egg without negotiation and asks where the body is. The size data is worth more to her than the eggs — she will not explain why.

JC’s claim about “multiple extra muscles” earns a 5 gp penalty per egg. Marta does not appreciate being lied to. If JC corrects himself (Mortis makes sustained deception painful), she restores the price without comment.

Transaction Purpose

JC intends to sell the eggs to fund the purchase of the Corto di Velo from Casa Lupo (30 gp, unidentified). At base offer, the sale leaves JC with 195 gp after the bow — substantial operating funds for a PC who arrived in Calveno with nothing.

Connections

  • Jean-Claude Tabarnack — owner
  • Marta Orsini / Studio Orsini — buyer
  • Casa Lupo — where the egg inquiry was redirected
  • Whip Shark — source creature
  • Corto di Velo — intended purchase with the proceeds
